whatIs.label: Is This Page For You?
whatIs.title: How Vulnerable is Your Business to Cyber Threats?
whatIs.paragraph1: Cyber attacks no longer exclusively target global giants. Small and medium-sized websites with weak firewalls are the number one target for ransomware and automated botnets.
whatIs.paragraph2: Getting hacked just once means the theft of customer data you've collected for years, being erased from Google search results (blacklisting), and suffering irreparable reputational damage.
whatIs.paragraph3: As Sybor Digital, we leave nothing to chance. We build your digital fortress with bank-grade firewalls, proactive penetration testing, and Disaster Recovery scenarios.

startup.title: Institutions Handling Sensitive Data
startup.description: I want to protect my brand reputation by securing patient, client, or user data in my system against leaks.

growing.title: Victims of Cyber Attacks
growing.description: My website has been hacked or infected with malware. I want it cleaned urgently and never want to live this nightmare again.

whatWeDo.label: How We Help You
whatWeDo.title: We Block Threats Before They Reach Your Door
whatWeDo.paragraph1: We don't leave security to a single plugin. We weave a multi-layered armor (WAF) around your website that detects and blocks malicious traffic, DDoS attacks, and SQL injections in seconds.
whatWeDo.paragraph2: We find vulnerabilities in your system before hackers do. With regular vulnerability scans and Penetration Testing, we ensure your infrastructure is always up to date and closed to attacks.
whatWeDo.paragraph3: We are always prepared for the worst-case scenario. Thanks to our fully automated, cloud-based, multi-location backup systems, even if your server crashes, we restore your site in minutes with zero data loss.

reason4.title: Transparent Security Reports

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Things you might be wondering about web security and backup processes.

delivery.question: How long does it take to install the security shield and backup system?
delivery.answer: Depending on the current structure and size of your site, the integration of SSL, WAF, and a fully automated backup system is usually completed within 3 to 7 days.

pricing.question: How is the cost of the security service determined?
pricing.answer: We operate with a one-time setup fee and a monthly subscription model for 24/7 active monitoring/backups. Pricing is determined based on your site traffic and data risk level.

revisions.question: My site is currently hacked (infected), can you help?
revisions.answer: Absolutely. First, we provide emergency intervention to clean your site from malicious code, close backdoors, and install our security shields so you never experience the same situation again.

maintenance.question: If the server crashes, how long does it take to restore the site from a backup?
maintenance.answer: Thanks to our Disaster Recovery plan, depending on the data size of your site, we generally restore your site completely with zero data loss within 30-60 minutes.

migration.question: Do you only provide security services for WordPress sites?
migration.answer: No. In addition to WordPress, we provide comprehensive server-based security solutions for modern technologies like Next.js, React, Webflow, and fully custom software infrastructures.

mobile.question: What exactly does KVKK / GDPR compliance cover?
mobile.answer: It covers the encrypted storage of data, prevention of unauthorized access, cookie management, and the technical integration of privacy policies into the system.
